page_title: Keep Your Code At Your Fingertips

summary.name: SnippetsLab
summary.one_liner: SnippetsLab is a macOS app for organizing, searching, and syncing code snippets and Markdown notes, with a menu bar companion for quick access.
use_cases: store and reuse frequently used code snippets
organize scripts, terminal commands and references
write Markdown notes with code blocks, LaTeX and diagrams
quickly insert or copy snippets from the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: SnippetsLab stores snippets in nested folders with tags, smart groups, and multiple tabs per snippet. It provides syntax highlighting for over 600 languages and automatic language detection for 50 popular ones. Its Markdown support includes Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX formulas, a table of contents, and a side-by-side preview with customizable CSS themes. A menu bar companion lets users create, browse, preview, copy, or insert snippets using keyboard shortcuts, and search covers full text with fuzzy matching.
notable: Menu bar companion with keyboard shortcuts for quick snippet access
Markdown support with Mermaid, LaTeX (MathJax), and live scroll-synced preview
Alfred Workflow and Raycast Extension integrations
iCloud Sync and optional publishing to GitHub Gists
caveats: Requires macOS 14.6 or later (Apple Silicon or Intel)
Page lists 'Universal App' among features, but platform support beyond macOS is not explicitly confirmed
